extra_vocab.en: to follow a rule or an agreement
extra_vocab.note: 多益最常見的用法是 abide by + 規則／合約／決定，語氣正式，常出現在公告、合約與公司規定中。另有「忍受」的意思，但通常只用在否定句，如 can't abide。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 表示「遵守」時一定要接 by（abide by the rules），不能直接接受詞，也不能寫成 abide to。

example.en: She always abides by the budget set by the finance team.
example.zh: 她總是遵守財務團隊訂定的預算。

example.en: The factory abided by the new environmental rules last year.
example.zh: 這間工廠去年遵守了新的環保規定。

example.en: We are abiding by the schedule agreed with the client.
example.zh: 我們正遵守與客戶約定的時程。

example.en: Every business must abide by the law in this country.
example.zh: 這個國家的每一家公司都必須遵守法律。

example.en: The firm promised to abide by the court's ruling.
example.zh: 這家公司承諾遵守法院的裁決。

example.en: New staff should abide by company policy at all times.
example.zh: 新進員工應隨時遵守公司政策。

examples.en: All employees must abide by the safety rules.
examples.zh: 所有員工都必須遵守安全規定。

examples.en: Both companies agreed to abide by the terms of the contract.
examples.zh: 兩家公司同意遵守合約條款。

examples.en: Suppliers who fail to abide by our standards will lose orders.
examples.zh: 未能遵守我們標準的供應商將失去訂單。

similar.diff: comply with 更常用在法規、標準，語氣正式；abide by 常用在規則、決定、合約。

example.en: Our products comply with international safety standards.
example.zh: 我們的產品符合國際安全標準。

similar.diff: obey 可直接接人或規則（obey the rules），語氣像「服從命令」；abide by 較像「遵守約定」。

example.en: Employees must obey the instructions of the safety officer.
example.zh: 員工必須服從安全主管的指示。

example.en: Please comply with the new safety rules.
example.zh: 請遵守新的安全規定。

example.en: Drivers must obey the traffic rules.
example.zh: 駕駛人必須遵守交通規則。

example.en: Please follow the steps in the manual.
example.zh: 請依照手冊上的步驟操作。

senses.en: to follow a rule or an agreement
senses.distinguish: 後面接 by，受詞是規則、合約或決定。

example.en: Our staff abide by a strict code of conduct.
example.zh: 我們的員工遵守嚴格的行為準則。

senses.en: to accept something you do not like
senses.distinguish: 沒有 by，通常用在 can't／cannot 之後，表示受不了。

example.en: I cannot abide waiting for slow replies from vendors.
example.zh: 我受不了等廠商緩慢的回覆。

extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於新品、書籍、餐廳或公司的報導與廣告，如 critical acclaim、widely acclaimed。當動詞是「公開稱讚」，常用被動 be acclaimed as。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: acclaim 當名詞是不可數，不加 a，也不加 s；當形容詞用時，常見的是過去分詞 acclaimed（廣受好評的）。

example.en: The magazine acclaims the new model for its simple design.
example.zh: 這本雜誌稱讚新款的簡約設計。

example.en: The press acclaimed the company's new CEO last month.
example.zh: 媒體上個月稱讚了公司的新執行長。

example.en: She is an acclaimed designer known for her office furniture.
example.zh: 她是以辦公家具聞名、廣受好評的設計師。

example.en: Many reviewers are acclaiming the new phone's long battery life.
example.zh: 許多評論者正稱讚新手機的長電池續航力。

example.en: The novel received critical acclaim after its release last spring.
example.zh: 這本小說去年春天發行後獲得評論界讚譽。

example.en: The software won wide acclaim among small business owners.
example.zh: 這套軟體在小型企業主之間廣受好評。

example.en: The company won acclaim for its fast customer service.
example.zh: 這家公司因快速的客戶服務而贏得讚譽。

examples.en: The restaurant has earned acclaim for its fresh local food.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳因新鮮的在地食材而獲得讚譽。

examples.en: Our hotel was acclaimed as the best in the region.
examples.zh: 我們的飯店被譽為該地區最棒的飯店。

examples.en: The director spoke about the acclaim our new product has received.
examples.zh: 主管談到我們的新產品所獲得的好評。

confusable.diff: claim 是「主張、索賠」，acclaim 是「公開的讚揚」，兩者意思不同。
confusable.usage: claim 可當可數名詞（an insurance claim）也可當動詞；acclaim 當名詞是不可數。

example.en: She filed an insurance claim after the storm damaged her shop.
example.zh: 暴風雨損壞她的店面後，她提出了保險理賠。

similar.diff: praise 較口語、用途廣，可用在個人；acclaim 多指大眾或媒體的公開讚美，語氣較正式。

example.en: The manager gave high praise to the sales team.
example.zh: 經理對業務團隊給予高度讚賞。

similar.diff: applaud 原指鼓掌，也可指公開稱讚某個決定或行動，後面常接決定、計畫。

example.en: Investors applauded the company's decision to cut costs.
example.zh: 投資人讚許公司降低成本的決定。

example.en: The staff received praise from the customers.
example.zh: 員工獲得顧客的稱讚。

example.en: Everyone applauded the team after the presentation.
example.zh: 簡報結束後大家都為團隊鼓掌。

example.en: The firm has a good reputation for quality.
example.zh: 這家公司在品質上享有好名聲。

example.en: The team's work received public acclaim this year.
example.zh: 團隊的作品今年獲得大眾的讚譽。

example.en: Critics often acclaim the museum as a must-see place.
example.zh: 評論家常稱讚這間博物館是必去之處。

extra_vocab.en: in a way that is exactly correct
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於報告、資料、測量與預測的情境，如 measure accurately、record accurately。強調結果與事實或數字相符，沒有錯誤。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: accurately 是副詞，可放在動詞前或受詞後（accurately record the data / record the data accurately）；修飾動詞時不能用形容詞 accurate。

example.en: The new device can measure room temperature accurately.
example.zh: 這個新裝置可以準確測量室溫。

example.en: Few analysts could predict sales accurately last year.
example.zh: 去年很少有分析師能準確預測銷售。

example.en: Please record every payment accurately in the system.
example.zh: 請在系統中準確記錄每一筆付款。

examples.en: The report accurately describes our sales in the last quarter.
examples.zh: 這份報告準確描述了我們上一季的銷售。

examples.en: Can you explain the problem accurately so we can fix it?
examples.zh: 你能準確說明問題，好讓我們修正嗎？

examples.en: Please make sure the figures are accurately entered in the form.
examples.zh: 請確認數字已正確填入表單。

confusable.diff: accordingly 是「因此、依情況」，和「準確」無關，只是拼法開頭相似。

example.en: The schedule changed, so we updated the plan accordingly.
example.zh: 時程改變了，所以我們相應地更新了計畫。

similar.diff: precisely 更強調細節與精確到細微處，也可用來強調「正是」。

example.en: The machine cuts the metal precisely to the size you need.
example.zh: 這台機器把金屬精確切成你需要的尺寸。

similar.diff: correctly 強調沒有錯誤；accurately 強調與事實或數值非常接近。

example.en: Please fill out the form correctly before you submit it.
example.zh: 提交前請正確填寫這份表單。

example.en: The meeting starts precisely at nine o'clock.
example.zh: 會議正好在九點開始。

example.en: The printer is not working correctly today.
example.zh: 印表機今天運作不正常。

example.en: The package arrived exactly on time.
example.zh: 包裹準時送達。

derived.link: accurately 去掉 -ly 就是形容詞，像 quick → quickly、careful → carefully
inaccurate + -ly，形容詞變副詞，意思和 accurately 相反

extra_vocab.en: to follow a rule closely, or to stick to something
extra_vocab.note: 多益最常見的用法是 adhere to + 規定／政策／時程／標準，語氣正式，常出現在公司公告與合約。也可指東西黏在表面上，如膠帶、標籤。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: adhere to 的 to 是介系詞，後面接名詞或 V-ing，不接原形動詞（adhere to following the rules，不寫 adhere to follow）。

example.en: The manager adheres to the same rules as everyone else.
example.zh: 經理和其他人一樣遵守同樣的規定。

example.en: The team adhered to the budget throughout the project.
example.zh: 團隊在整個專案期間都遵守預算。

example.en: We are adhering to the delivery schedule this month.
example.zh: 我們這個月正遵守交貨時程。

example.en: All branches must adhere to the same refund policy.
example.zh: 所有分店都必須遵守相同的退款政策。

example.en: It is hard to adhere to a schedule when staff are away.
example.zh: 員工不在時很難遵守時程。

example.en: Please adhere to the guidelines when you write the report.
example.zh: 撰寫報告時請遵守準則。

examples.en: Employees are required to adhere to the dress code.
examples.zh: 員工必須遵守服裝規定。

examples.en: The supplier failed to adhere to the agreed delivery date.
examples.zh: 供應商未能遵守約定的交貨日期。

examples.en: This label adheres well to both glass and plastic.
examples.zh: 這個標籤能牢牢黏在玻璃和塑膠上。

confusable.diff: adopt 是「採用」新方法或新政策；adhere 是「遵守」已有的規則。
confusable.usage: adopt 是及物動詞，直接接受詞（adopt a plan）；adhere 要加 to 才能接受詞（adhere to a plan）。

example.en: The company decided to adopt a new filing system.
example.zh: 公司決定採用新的檔案系統。

similar.diff: comply with 多用於法規與標準，強調符合要求；adhere to 強調持續遵循、堅持不變。

example.en: Our software complies with the latest privacy laws.
example.zh: 我們的軟體符合最新的隱私法規。

similar.diff: stick to 較口語，常用於計畫、預算、議程；adhere to 較正式。

example.en: Please stick to the agenda so the meeting ends on time.
example.zh: 請依照議程進行，讓會議準時結束。

example.en: Please follow the instructions on the label.
example.zh: 請遵照標籤上的說明。

example.en: All factories must comply with the safety law.
example.zh: 所有工廠都必須遵守安全法規。

example.en: The price tag will not stick to a wet box.
example.zh: 價格標籤無法黏在潮濕的箱子上。

senses.en: to follow a rule, plan, or standard
senses.distinguish: 後面接 to + 規定、計畫或標準，主詞通常是人或公司。

example.en: Our team adheres to the safety plan on every project.
example.zh: 我們團隊在每個專案都遵守安全計畫。

senses.distinguish: 後面接 to + 物體表面，主詞通常是膠帶、標籤等物品。

example.en: The tape adheres firmly to clean, dry surfaces.
example.zh: 這種膠帶能牢牢黏在乾淨乾燥的表面。
